## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T830 in one fascicle is Divākara's **second translation** (再譯 *zàiyì*) of the *Anakṣara-karaṇḍaka-vairocana-garbha-sūtra*, the same source-text as *[Wúzì bǎoqiè jīng 無字寶篋經 (T828)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0534)* by Bodhiruci and his own *[Dàshèng lí wénzì pǔguāngmíng zàng jīng (T829)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0535)*. The fact that both T829 and T830 are by Divākara — explicitly marked 再譯 ("re-translated") — reflects the late-Táng practice of producing successive refinements of the same source within a single translator's career. The Taishō editors retained both versions side-by-side. CANWWW gives the alternate Sanskrit title *Anakṣara-granthaka-garbha-sūtra*.

**Abstract**

The narrative frame and doctrinal content are identical to those of [T828](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0534) and [T829](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0535): the assembly at Mt Gṛdhrakūṭa; the bodhisattva Shèngsīwéi's two questions; the Buddha's exposition of the eight (or nine) *kleśa*s the *bodhisattva* must extinguish; the Buddha's exposition of the *anakṣara-dharma*-ground that the Tathāgata has awakened to. See [KR6i0534](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0534) for the full doctrinal summary.

The chief differences between T829 and T830 — both by Divākara — are at the level of phrasing and bodhisattva-name selection: T830 renders the title as *Biànzhào guāngmíng zàng* (the more etymologically transparent rendering of *vairocana-garbha*), where T829 had *Pǔguāngmíng zàng*. The doctrinal content is unchanged. The two-translation situation within Divākara's own career is one of the few preserved instances in the Chinese canon of an intra-translator revision.
